468:t_036:7.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「That's right...! That moment will be the start of the true battle!」

468:t_036:9.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Don't get carried away, humans! No matter how well you master the power of light, you're worthless in the face of the gods' battle!」

468:t_036:10.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「You will learn that in time! And that time is nearly upon you!」

468:t_037:1.en:
$$渓$$
「No need to be scared. However big a bluff he pulls, if he's come back to life, we'll just hit him right back and put him down.」

468:t_037:2.en:
$$凱$$
「Exactly. We've got the Demon God of Light on our side, too.」

468:t_037:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「Look who's talking, $$凱$$! You were pretty rattled when $$ガラダブラ$$ showed up!」

468:t_037:4.en:
$$凱$$
「I don't want to hear that from a guy who's fighting because the $$くろがね五人衆$$ are kicking his butt.」

468:t_037:6.en:
$$つばさ$$
「Yeah. I worried you and put you through a lot, too.」

468:t_037:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's not have that between a parent and child.」

468:t_037:11.en:
$$つばさ$$
「He climbed out of the culture fluid just to get Photon Power energy to you. He knew what he was risking.」

468:t_037:14.en:
$$つばさ$$
「I took his life once... So this time, I'll do everything I can to keep it going.」

468:t_037:15.en:
$$甲児$$
「Got it. I'll leave Dad to you, Mom.」

468:t_037:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's a matter between husband and wife, after all.」

468:t_037:17.en:
$$竜馬$$
「...Talking like a grown man now...」

468:t_037:21.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... Getting worn out over that little bit. I've really lost my edge...」

468:t_037:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「...Sorry... Let me sleep... for a bit... I'll......」

468:t_038:1.en:
$$安$$
「You bet! We're not the $$くろがね五人衆$$ for nothing!」

468:t_038:2.en:
$n
「They might even be stronger than the $$ボロット$$ unit itself.」

468:t_038:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「W-what's that supposed to mean!? $$ボロット$$ counts everyone's power too!」

468:t_038:4.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「Even if you're jealous, we're not sharing!」

468:t_038:6.en:
$$お菊$$
「Now, now, boys... Don't be so mean.」

468:t_038:7.en:
$$お菊$$
「$n... I hear that sub-seat over there is open. If you like, shall I go in your place?」

468:t_100:0.en:
$$甲児$$
(I have to go after $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I don't have time for a guy like this!)

468:t_100:1.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Your mind is elsewhere, I see! Don't think you can beat me in that state!」

468:t_100:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Damn it! I guess I can't move on without taking this guy down!」

468:t_100:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then all I can do is fight! Get ready, $$ガラダブラ$$!」

468:t_101:0.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Humans! Don't think that was all of Lord $$ハーデス$$'s power!」

468:t_101:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Are you all right, $$竜馬$$!? Is the wound from covering for me hurting you!?」

468:t_101:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't worry about me! I've taught you plenty about what happens when you lose focus in a fight!」

468:t_101:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「Oss! Of course I haven't forgotten!」

468:t_101:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Then quit thinking about stupid stuff! Let's hurry up and finish off these dead men back from hell!」

468:t_102:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
(Hang in there, $$甲児$$...! I'll be right there!)

468:t_102:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
(I'll never let you die! I'll save you even if it costs me my life!)

468:t_103:1.en:
$n
(Damn...! Don't think about anything extra now! Focus on beating the enemy, nothing else!)
